name: Uv2 — Učitavanje dokumenata
afterNav: (async()=>{ Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b=>b.textContent.trim()==='Dalje').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,60)); const input=document.querySelector('input[type=file]'); const files=[new File(['x'],'Knjiga_prihoda_2026.xlsx',{type:'application/vnd.ms-excel'}), new File(['x'],'Faktura_25-26-03.pdf',{type:'application/pdf'}), new File(['x'],'Izvod_maj_2026.pdf',{type:'application/pdf'})]; const dt=new DataTransfer(); files.forEach(f=>dt.items.add(f)); input.files=dt.files; input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); })()

name: Uv6 — Gotovo
afterNav: (async()=>{ function wait(ms){return new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));} async function find(sel){ for(let i=0;i<20;i++){ const el=document.querySelector(sel); if(el) return el; await wait(50);} return null; } async function findBtn(label){ for(let i=0;i<20;i++){ const el=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b=>b.textContent.trim()===label); if(el) return el; await wait(50);} return null; } const radio=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.uvoz-radio-card')).find(e=>e.textContent.includes('Unesi ručno')); radio.click(); await wait(80); (await findBtn('Dalje')).click(); const setter=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set; const di=await find('input[type=date]'); setter.call(di,'2026-04-10'); di.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); const ci=await find('input[placeholder=\'Izaberi klijenta\']'); setter.call(ci,'Test Klijent'); ci.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); const ai=await find('input[type=number]'); setter.call(ai,'500'); ai.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); await wait(100); (await findBtn('Sačuvaj prihode')).click(); await wait(200); })()
